decks.plan: Use enchantments as the primary engine, stock the graveyard, then reuse valuable non-Aura enchantments through Anikthea while building an enchantment-creature/token board. Enchantress value and recursion matter more than Aura Voltron.
decks.reason: They look enchantment-synergistic but push Aura Voltron, while Anikthea specifically wants non-Aura enchantments to recur.

decks.plan: Resolve and protect Krenko, give him haste or repeated untaps, exponentially grow the Goblin count, then turn the swarm into combat damage, sacrifice value, or burst mana.
decks.reason: Expensive generic red value should not outrank cards that directly increase Krenko activations or exploit the Goblin mass.

cards.name: The Shattered States Era // Nameless Conqueror

decks.plan: Sacrifice creatures and tokens for value, double death-triggered abilities with Teysa, and win through drain, recursive fodder, and death payoffs.
decks.reason: Token quantity alone should not turn the deck into generic lifegain or +1/+1-counter go-wide.

cards.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

decks.archetype: Targeted spell copying / wide creature board
decks.plan: Build a creature board, then target Zada with cheap instants and sorceries so those spells are copied across the entire team. Repeated cantrips generate explosive card advantage, while pump, token production and mana-generating effects convert the copied spells into a large combat or storm-style turn.
decks.reason: Both are broadly useful mono-red value cards, but neither meaningfully participates in Zada's target-and-copy engine. Generic red value should not outrank spells or backup engines that exploit a wide creature board through targeted spell copying.
decks.provenance: User supplied before first ranking evaluation

cards.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

decks.plan: Cast cheap Equipment and Auras to keep Sram drawing, efficiently attach them to a threat, and turn equip/attachment synergy into a compact Voltron engine.
decks.reason: Vehicles technically trigger Sram, but that alone should not make a Vehicle package strategically important in an Equipment-focused list.

cards.name: Thousand Moons Smithy // Barracks of the Thousand

decks.plan: Chain creatures to turn Chulane into card and land velocity, then repeatedly bounce and recast creatures to reuse cast and ETB effects.
decks.reason: Chulane puts lands onto the battlefield, but that should not cause pure landfall-token cards to displace creature-cast/bounce engines.

decks.plan: Sacrifice creatures for value, build experience, and repeatedly recur creature-based removal, ramp, tutors, and value pieces through Meren.
decks.reason: Meren's experience counters are on the player. Generic permanent/+1/+1 counter amplification should not be mistaken for direct support.

decks.plan: Connect with Brago and repeatedly blink useful nonland permanents to reuse ETBs, removal, draw and control pieces until repeated value or a loop takes over.
decks.reason: Brago uses plenty of artifacts as infrastructure, but artifact density should not incorrectly turn it into an artifact-token deck.

decks.plan: Convert every token source into additional Squirrels, then spend those bodies as sacrifice resources for removal, drain, mana and combo value.
decks.reason: Incidental lifegain/life-loss overlap should not outrank the much stronger token-generation and sacrifice relationships.

decks.plan: Ramp aggressively into Gishath, connect in combat, and maximize Dinosaur hit density and top-deck quality so Gishath's damage turns into a large board of Dinosaurs.
decks.reason: Beast Whisperer rewards casting creatures while Gishath cheats many directly into play; Hardened Scales has no reason to score highly without a real counter package.
